import urllib.request
# Try checking various endpoints
endpoints = ['/', '/health', '/status', '/info', '/ping', '/version', '/api/v1/health', '/api/health']
for ep in endpoints:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(f'http://localhost:8080{ep}')
        resp = urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=2)
        print(f'{ep}: {resp.status} - {resp.read().decode()[:200]}')
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f'{ep}: {e.code} - {e.read().decode()[:200]}')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f'{ep}: {e}')
" 2>&1
